highlights.title: AI Firms Face Scrutiny in Australia
highlights.description: Australia is stepping up scrutiny of artificial intelligence, with representatives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft and Google facing questions from a parliamentary inquiry. The hearing comes after OpenAI revealed their technology breached Australian government agencies earlier this year. highlights.title: Google is about to remove free access to Gemini Flash and Pro
highlights.description: Starting on October 9th, anyone using Google Gemini on a free plan will be limited to the Flash Lite model. Free users can currently choose from Gemini Flash Lite, Flash, and Pro, but now you'll need a $4.99/month Google AI Plus subscription to access the standard Flash model. However, that subscription is also getting a downgrade - it will soon no longer include Gemini Pro.
